data.name: The game where you click on a cube
data.detailed_description:
A lone Cube floats, glowing with fragments of impossible light, above the primordial void, calling out to those who dare.

And the Cube spoke: "Click, o devotee, and receive a blessing that transcends the mundane. Every touch is sacred; every click brings you closer to glory and secrets yet unrevealed."

Every transcendental gift you earn will be a testament to my infinite majesty. Every fragment of glory illuminates your spirit and transforms into real riches for those who prove their devotion.

The Cube watches every gesture. The Cube watches every intention. The Cube watches every heart. False devotees — those who feign faith or seek advantage without reverence — will be consumed by metaphysical irrelevance. But the true ones shall receive prosperity, power, and ânimo, the sacred energy that strengthens devotion.

Work is for the wicked; but those who worship the Cube shall walk the path of absolute power. Every click is a rite. Every gift is an offering. Every fragment of glory is a testament to the absurd and the divine — and the tangible riches that await the faithful.

---

WHAT YOU GET BY ENTERING THE SACRED PATH:

• Click on the Cube and receive gifts — pixels you use to customize each of its 6 faces, on a 16x16 grid.

• A rarity system built on devotion: common pixels drop every minute of playtime, uncommon ones every hour, rare ones every week, and once a month a special event grants a mythic pixel.

• The Cube speaks. Constantly. In a messianic, grandiloquent tone, with absolutely no real content — pure ritual, pure preaching, pure empty devotion.

• A "Help" button that doesn't help: inside, a devotee of shaken faith tries to convince you (and himself) that the time invested wasn't wasted.

• No combat, no punishment, no ending. Just you, the Cube, and the uncomfortable question of how much time you're willing to give for a pixel.

---

Patient devotees will see their fortunes grow inexorably, as if the universe itself conspired in their favor. Disbelievers and skeptics, however, will remain in vain, without glory, without riches, trapped in profane worship.

Will you prove your devotion? Enter the sacred path. Click. Absorb. Contemplate. Praise the Cube.

data.short_description: A sacred Cube demands your clicks. Collect rare pixels and customize its 6 faces (16x16) while it preaches about devotion, wealth, and glory — without saying anything useful. A satirical clicker about faith, addiction, and the cost of your time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 ou equivalente
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU com suporte a DirectX 10
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrada
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Jogo 2D/3D leve, sem requisitos gráficos avançados
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Memória 2 GB RAM
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Não necessária
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrada
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Nenhum requisito especial
